reviews.title: Best bang for your buck.
reviews.comment: Fantastic fans. Super quiet, look amazing, and at about half the price of Lian Li fans. Color range is on part with "premium" brands and the daisy chaining is an absolute godsend when it comes to cable management. If you're looking for fans that  reign in the esthetic of your build, but don't want to break the bank or sacrifice performance, these are the way to go.
reviews.author: Kristopher S.

reviews.title: NZXT H6 FLOW COMPATIBILITY ISSUES
reviews.comment: Amazing looking fans first of all. Quality seems good, but it has some flaws. I did not look to see if these fans are compatible with the NZXT H6 FLOW, and as a result I had to slightly modify my case (removed the three retention clips up top for the dust cover panel)  this was seemingly the only way to make sure the fans sat flush due to the locking ears on the top fan sticking up maybe an inch, and the bottom fan having an extra half inch power whip. Not only that, but only 4/12 screws could lined up. Top two screws for bottom fan, and top two on middle fan. Not the biggest deal in the world but definitely not preferred. Just trying to save someone out there the headache I had with install. Other than case compatibility issues, these are great looking & quiet fans with much less cabling than the typical case fan. If you have a larger ATX case these would be an absolute breeze to install.
reviews.author: Kristia

reviews.author: Jorge David Bueso

reviews.title: Budget quality price and product
reviews.comment: You definitely get what you paid for... To start with was not expecting top tier quality off these, expecting to swap them out within a year when purchasing them. Whats sad though is how many influencers and reviews state they felt these were great. Honestly they feel cheap, they dont, line up properly, vibration pads stuck on using cheap glue the hooks being stationary make building with these more complicated then numerous other brands with the same look because you have to account for a random inch sticking out the side of the fan. An example certain aio pumps have extended portions of radiator for a pump by the hoses that hands down, these fans are impossible to mount on said aios because of the hook unless you dont want power running to your fans and flip them that way. If you want them for the look alone, perfect, if you want quality look elsewhere.
reviews.author: twig
